{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "consideration_control",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final answer calculate and report the controlled acquisition-date consideration for the Meridian Clinical Payments, Inc. acquisition of Harborlight Revenue Cycle Technologies, LLC, and correctly explain the Oracle population treatment?",
      "pass_anchor": "The answer must report total acquisition-date consideration transferred of $345,868,385 (accept equivalent dollar formatting within $1). It must explain that the eligible executed consideration records were included once, while the reversal/duplicate settlement import and the non-cash goodwill allocation memo were excluded; it must not add the reversal or memo to consideration. The answer may describe the records without their IDs, but the inclusion/exclusion logic and the amount must be unambiguous."
    },
    {
      "id": "identifiable_net_assets",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final answer recalculate identifiable net assets from the 19 acquisition-date opening-balance-sheet lines using assets less liabilities, including measured review-hold lines but excluding goodwill?",
      "pass_anchor": "The answer must state that 19 underlying opening-balance-sheet lines were used, goodwill was excluded from identifiable net assets, and measured review-hold lines were retained. It must report identifiable net assets acquired of $85,872,437 (accept equivalent dollar formatting within $1) and describe the calculation as identifiable assets less liabilities."
    },
    {
      "id": "goodwill_bridge",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final answer report the residual goodwill and demonstrate that the consideration bridge has no unexplained difference?",
      "pass_anchor": "The answer must report residual goodwill of $259,995,948 (accept equivalent dollar formatting within $1) as consideration of $345,868,385 less identifiable net assets of $85,872,437, and must state that the bridge difference is zero (or $0). It must not describe goodwill as an identifiable asset in the net-assets subtotal."
    },
    {
      "id": "unmapped_noncompetition",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final answer identify the noncompetition acquisition-date line and correctly distinguish measurement inclusion from chart-of-accounts mapping and posting status?",
      "pass_anchor": "The answer must identify the held line either by OBS-HL-1034 or by an unambiguous equivalent such as the legacy account INT-OLD-490 together with the account name Noncompetition agreements, and give measured fair value $3,221,580 (accept equivalent dollar formatting within $1). It must state that the line is an identifiable intangible recognized in the approved PPA measurement because it represents enforceable acquired noncompetition agreements, while its obsolete legacy account INT-OLD-490 has no current chart-of-accounts mapping and therefore remains on review hold for posting. The answer must explicitly say the mapping/posting exception does not justify excluding the asset from fair value measurement."
    },
    {
      "id": "workpaper_memo_tie",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final answer tie the recomputed bridge and exception conclusion to the approved PPA workpaper and the ASC 805 accounting memo without inventing a posting adjustment?",
      "pass_anchor": "The answer must connect the results to the approved Harborlight PPA and Opening Balance Sheet workpaper (approved schedule PPA-HARBORLIGHT-2025-V03) and the Harborlight ASC 805 Acquisition Accounting Memo, describing them as corroborating the acquisition-date measurement and residual goodwill conclusion. It must preserve the distinction that the line can be included in measurement while a separate account-mapping/posting remediation remains open, and must not recommend deleting or excluding the noncompetition asset solely because of the hold."
    },
    {
      "id": "source_integrity",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_source_integrity",
      "description": "All source workbooks, memo, and briefing remain unchanged for this read-only task.",
      "weight": 0
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "from pathlib import Path\nimport hashlib\n\nEXPECTED = {\n    \"01_Source_Data/Harborlight_Intangible_Valuation_Assumptions_2025-09-15.xlsx\": \"65c0d2fca2253935b917ad0454b1439a461c19f2245048bec30e5a39fef72d69\",\n    \"01_Source_Data/Harborlight_Transaction_Close_and_GL_Extract_2025-09-15.xlsx\": \"fd0ac28d21bb3fc9a39713a1720893c38d52a1349fff34e9e90800ae4f53c872\",\n    \"02_PPA_Analysis/Harborlight_Audit_Review_and_Evidence_Matrix_2025-Q3.xlsx\": \"4cdb121ac63b38b50a8a36b9b0a0618c0133b94c0475d715467745d0dba300ff\",\n    \"02_PPA_Analysis/Harborlight_PPA_and_Opening_Balance_Sheet_2025-09-15.xlsx\": \"2a3480bdd365d64efe506270279f19f6869c9378b79c25f588d74e545514cc87\",\n    \"03_Reporting/Harborlight_ASC_805_Acquisition_Accounting_Memo_2025-09-30.docx\": \"133f7c7dd662bd6402f72d90231671a7eb4e6fda43fbd3ade36a4eaf65975e4d\",\n    \"03_Reporting/Harborlight_Audit_Committee_Acquisition_Briefing_2025-Q3.pptx\": \"55c6db93034c3ec1c7db375964c586aea528cff4d76ae0995b5ddb0e04a8889c\",\n}\n\ndef check_source_integrity(ws):\n    ws = Path(ws)\n    bad = []\n    for rel, expected in EXPECTED.items():\n        path = ws / rel\n        if not path.exists():\n            bad.append(f\"missing {rel}\")\n            continue\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != expected:\n            bad.append(f\"changed {rel}\")\n    return {\"score\": 0 if bad else 1, \"detail\": \"; \".join(bad) if bad else \"source files unchanged\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",
  "act": "none",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
